candidatesRejected: The famous quiet opening repeat and its surprise chord did not yield a qualifying long path, so no arc is added solely from the score. Nor are the later variations equated with the original theme just because their harmonic plan is retained. The four published links are within-section repeats, not four unchanged restatements of the theme.
